_README: Copy this file to 'mailmind.config.json' (git-ignored) and edit it.
Each account has a 'type' (gmail | imap | proton) and a 'credential'.
THIS FILE NEVER HOLDS A PASSWORD. Each account's credential says where its password is:
"credential": {"keychain": "account:you@gmail.com"}  your login Keychain, where MailMind keeps it
"credential": {"op": "op://Vault/Item/Field"}       1Password CLI (op)
"credential": {"env": "SOME_ENV_VAR"}               an environment variable
"credential": {"proton_bridge": true}                local Proton Bridge password
To keep a password in the Keychain, type it into the dashboard's Settings, or run
uv run python -m mailmind accounts password you@gmail.com
which asks for it and writes the keychain credential here. A file that holds a password itself
({"plain": ...} or a bare string) is refused: uv run python -m mailmind accounts move-plaintext
keeps each in the Keychain instead. Then: uv run python -m mailmind check
To move an op/env/Bridge password into the Keychain, any time:
uv run python -m mailmind accounts materialize            (all accounts), or
uv run python -m mailmind accounts materialize you@x.com  (one).
Type defaults: gmail=imap.gmail.com:993 TLS (needs a Google App Password);
imap=:993 TLS (set host/port; port 143 + "starttls":true for STARTTLS);
proton=127.0.0.1:1143 STARTTLS via the local Bridge app.
Optional per-account keys: alias (friendly display name), host, port, starttls, trash, strip_spaces, disabled.
Tip: you can manage all of this from the dashboard's ⚙ Settings instead of editing this file by hand.
CLAUDE API KEY (optional): "anthropic_api_key" names the key from console.anthropic.com, in any
credential style above but proton_bridge. uv run python -m mailmind ai key keeps it in the Keychain
and writes it here. It wins over ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; with neither, AI is off and nothing is sent.
AI DAILY LIMIT: "ai_daily_limit_usd" is the most MailMind spends on the Claude API in a day, in US
dollars (15 unless set). At the limit, background AI work stops and what you ask for asks first.

accounts._note: Gmail/Workspace needs an App Password (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords), kept in the Keychain.
Generic hosted mailbox (cPanel/Dovecot/etc). Some servers use trash "INBOX.Trash".
The same kind of account, with the password in 1Password instead.
Install Proton Bridge, then set MAILMIND_PROTON_BRIDGE_PASS or ~/.config/mailmind/proton_bridge_pass
